purpose: Build observable, fail-closed, repeatable income pipelines whose economics and dependence on owner labor can be measured. No sample, projection, or network success may be presented as real income.
five_why: Why is an income pipeline useful? It should turn a repeatable value-delivery process into observable cash-flow opportunities.
Why can it fail? A connector, customer source, delivery step, cost assumption, or dependency may break.
Why require real evidence? Activity and projected revenue are not payment.
Why require cost/time accounting? Gross receipts can hide negative economics or owner overwork.
Why require reversibility? A pipeline must be stoppable before losses, compliance risk, or dependency failure compound.

risk_boundary.credentials: Never embed user secrets in evidence or repository.
risk_boundary.compliance: User-configured production connectors remain NOT VERIFIED until authorized and exercised.
risk_boundary.stop_rule: Every pipeline requires max loss/time/attempt limits and a reversible disable switch.
